def _nominal_support(self, lemma, senses, start, end):
        context = {
            token.lemma_.casefold()
            for token in self.doc[start + 1 : end]
            if token.pos_ == "NOUN" and token.lemma_.casefold() != lemma
        }
        if not context:
            return {"code": "NO_NOMINAL_CONTEXT"}
        context_nodes = set()
        witnessed_words = set()
        for word in sorted(context):
            alternatives = self._senses(word)
            if len(alternatives) == 1:
                context_nodes.update(next(iter(alternatives.values())).nodes)
                witnessed_words.add(word)
        support = {
            key: sorted(sense.anchors & witnessed_words)
            for key, sense in senses.items()
            if sense.anchors & witnessed_words
        }
        common = set.intersection(*(set(sense.nodes) for sense in senses.values())) if len(senses) > 1 else set()
        scores = sorted(
            (
                (_jaccard(set(sense.nodes) - common, context_nodes), key)
                for key, sense in senses.items()
                if (sense.nodes - common) & context_nodes
            ),
            reverse=True,
        )
        thread = (
            scores[0][1]
            if scores and scores[0][0] > (scores[1][0] if len(scores) > 1 else 0) + _COHERENCE_MARGIN
            else None
        )
        if thread:
            # Eligibility and lexical witnesses are established above. The
            # production coherence selector, not a parallel similarity resolver,
            # then consumes the native type threads. Common nodes carry no WSD
            # signal and are removed on both sides, as in the diagnostics.
            ordered = sorted(senses)
            threads = {lemma: [tuple(sorted(senses[key].nodes - common)) for key in ordered]}
            threads.update(
                (word, [tuple(sorted(next(iter(self._senses(word).values())).nodes))])
                for word in sorted(witnessed_words)
            )
            entities = [Entity(Atom(word, pos="NOUN")) for word in threads]
            chosen = _select_by_coherence(entities, _NativeThreads(threads), native_only=True)
            selected_thread = chosen.get(_signature(entities[0]), ())
            if selected_thread != threads[lemma][ordered.index(thread)]:
                thread = None
        anchor = next(iter(support)) if len(support) == 1 else None
        evidence = {"native_anchor_support": support, "type_coherence": dict((key, score) for score, key in scores)}
        if thread:
            evidence["type_thread_candidate"] = thread
        if not support:
            code = "TYPE_COHERENCE_WITHOUT_LEXICAL_WITNESS" if thread else "INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXTUAL_SUPPORT"
            return {"code": code, **evidence}
        if thread and thread not in support:
            return {"code": "CONTEXTUAL_WITNESSES_DISAGREE", **evidence}
        selected = anchor or thread

def _construction_support(self, position, lemma, senses, *, definition_only=False):
        """Bind multiple gloss cues or an exact derivation in a linked clause."""
        tokens, linked = self._construction_span(position)
        cues = {
            token.lemma_: token.pos_
            for token in tokens
            if token.i != position
            and token.lemma_ != lemma
            and token.pos_ in _CONTENT_POS
            and token.lemma_ not in _GENERIC_TERMS
            and not token.is_stop
            and not is_numeral(token.lemma_)
        }
        type_witness = self._construction_type(position, tokens, linked)
        predication = self._definition_predication(position)
        derivations = {word: _verb_derivations(word) for word, pos in cues.items() if pos == "VERB"}
        linked_verbs = {t.lemma_ for t in tokens if linked is not None and t.i > linked and t.pos_ == "VERB"}
        witnesses, definition_witnesses = {}, {}
        for entry_id, sense in senses.items():
            gloss = dict(_gloss_content(sense.gloss))
            matched = frozenset(gloss.keys() & cues.keys())
            exact, related = self._derivation_support(sense, gloss, matched, derivations, linked_verbs, type_witness)
            verb_match = any(gloss[word] == cues[word] == "VERB" for word in matched)
            typed = self._matches_construction_type(sense, type_witness, matched, gloss)

                    "exact_derivation": exact,
                    "related_derivation": related,
                    "construction_type": predication if repeated else type_witness if typed or related else None,
                }
                if repeated:
                    definition_witnesses[entry_id] = witnesses[entry_id]

def _pos(self, surf: str, i: int, surfaces: List[str]) -> str:
        low = surf.lower()
        previous = surfaces[i - 1] if i > 0 else ""
        prev = previous.lower() if isinstance(previous, str) else ""
        if _PUNCT_RE.fullmatch(surf):
            return "PUNCT"
        if surf.replace(",", "").replace(".", "").isdigit():
            return "NUM"
        if (
            low in _AUX_MODAL
            and i > 0
            and (surfaces[i - 1].lower() in _POSS_PRON or surfaces[i - 1].lower() in ("the", "a", "an"))
        ):
            # A modal homograph right after an article or possessive is the NOUN, not the modal:
            # "makes his will" / "opened the can". A SUBJECT pronoun ("he will go") is not in this
            # set, so the modal reading is preserved. Without this, "will" tagged AUX is dropped as a
            # function word and "his will" collapses to the bare possessor (make(alonso, alonso)).
            return "NOUN"
        if low in _AUX_BE or low in _AUX_MODAL or low in _AUX_DO:
            return "AUX"
        if low in _NT_STEM and i + 1 < len(surfaces) and surfaces[i + 1].lower() == "n't":
            return "AUX"
        if low in ("has", "have", "had", "'ve"):
            # Perfect auxiliary ("had murdered Duncan") vs main/possessive verb ("had a
            # crown"): a determiner/pronoun/preposition next → the main verb; a verb
            # (the participle) next → the perfect auxiliary. Scan past intervening
            # adverbs/negation ("had never murdered"). Without this, "had" was tagged
            # VERB and stole the predicate slot, dropping the real verb (have(x,y)).

            while j < len(surfaces) and (surfaces[j].lower().endswith("ly") or surfaces[j].lower() in _NEG):
                j += 1
            nxt = surfaces[j].lower() if j < len(surfaces) else ""

            return "PART"

            return "PRON"
        if low in _DET and low not in _PRON:

        if low in _PRON and low != "that":

        if low in _CCONJ:

            return "VERB"
        if has_a:

"""Development regressions through actual native encoder and composed consumers.

The three reported failures and subsequently inspected cases are development,
not a fresh final holdout or evidence of full workload acceptance.
"""

import pytest

from GSE.api import GSEEncoder
from GSE.symbolic import emit_contract, evaluate_tree, from_trace, resolve
from GSE.symbolic.expression import Negation
from GSE.symbolic.predicates import Event, Temporal, TypeAssertion
from GSE.symbolic.queries import is_logically_equal_to


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def encoder():
    with GSEEncoder() as instance:
        instance.conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        yield instance


def compose(encoder, text):
    return evaluate_tree(resolve(from_trace(encoder.encode(text))))


def test_spatial_opposites_reach_query_and_emitted_contract(encoder):
    above = compose(encoder, "The bird is above the tree.")
    below = compose(encoder, "The bird is below the tree.")
    assert isinstance(above, Event) and isinstance(below, Event)
    assert (above.verb, below.verb) == ("above", "below")
    assert above.agent.head.lemma == below.agent.head.lemma == "bird"
    assert above.patient.head.lemma == below.patient.head.lemma == "tree"
    assert not is_logically_equal_to(above, below)
    assert emit_contract(above)["predicate"]["features"]["verb"] == "above"
    assert emit_contract(below)["predicate"]["features"]["verb"] == "below"
    negated = compose(encoder, "The bird is not above the tree.")
    assert isinstance(negated, Negation) and negated.operand.verb == "above"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("linker,anchor", [("before", "dawn"), ("after", "noon"), ("after", "winter")])
def test_native_time_typed_nominal_is_setting_not_patient(encoder, linker, anchor):
    tree = compose(encoder, f"Alice arrived {linker} {anchor}.")
    assert isinstance(tree, Temporal) and tree.conjunction == linker
    assert tree.setting.head.lemma == anchor
    assert isinstance(tree.event, Event) and tree.event.verb == "arrive"
    assert tree.event.agent.head.lemma == "alice" and tree.event.patient is None
    assert emit_contract(tree)["predicate"]["features"]["conjunction"] == linker


@pytest.mark.parametrize("linker", ["before", "after"])
def test_existing_clausal_temporal_arguments_remain_events(encoder, linker):
    tree = compose(encoder, f"Alice arrived {linker} Bob left.")
    assert isinstance(tree, Temporal) and tree.conjunction == linker
    assert isinstance(tree.setting, Event) and tree.setting.verb == "leave"
    assert isinstance(tree.event, Event) and tree.event.verb == "arrive"


def test_non_time_anchor_cannot_become_temporal_from_preposition_alone(encoder):
    assert not isinstance(compose(encoder, "Alice stood before the king."), Temporal)


def test_native_chemical_identity_survives_nominal_copula_and_emission(encoder):
    trace = encoder.encode("He is an inert gas.")
    assert trace.tokens[0].lexical_evidence["selected_record"]["entry_id"] == "wordnet:he:helium.n.01"
    gas = next(t for t in trace.tokens if t.lemma == "gas")
    assert gas.pos == "NOUN" and "SYN_COMPL" in gas.sent_primitives
    tree = evaluate_tree(resolve(from_trace(trace)))
    assert isinstance(tree, TypeAssertion)
    assert tree.entity.head.lemma == "he"
    assert emit_contract(tree)["predicate"]["op"] == "TYPE_ASSERT"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text,verb", [("He gases the room.", "gas"), ("He is moving.", "move"), ("He was killed.", "kill")]
)
def test_nominal_copula_repair_does_not_override_main_progressive_or_passive_verb(encoder, text, verb):
    tree = compose(encoder, text)
    assert isinstance(tree, Event) and tree.verb == verb

    assert evidence["contextual_grounding"]["code"] == "EXACT_WORDNET_SENSE"
    assert token.pos == "NOUN"  # prevents subsequent pronoun recency binding

    assert evidence["domains"] == encoder.lookup_definition("wordnet:he:helium.n.01")["selected"]["domains"]
